source: Built-in catalog: regional planting charts for cool-spring, continental and Atlantic climates, plus added crops
format: Ranges are days from the last spring frost (L) or first fall frost (F).

profiles.atlantic: Cool, late spring with a long fall

crops.name: Asparagus
crops.notes: First real harvest in the third spring.

crops.name: Garlic
crops.notes: Plant cloves. Fall planting is harvested the next July.

crops.name: Rhubarb
crops.notes: First harvest in the second or third spring.

crops.name: Potato
crops.notes: Plant seed potatoes. Early varieties about 70 days, main crop about 110.

crops.name: Cilantro
crops.notes: Bolts in summer heat, so sow small batches every 2 to 3 weeks.

crops.name: Parsley
crops.notes: Flat-leaf (Italian) and curly are timed the same.
